CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #9
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Best practice when working on Swimming: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Swimming with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Swimming.
   C. Damage equipment used for Swimming.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Swimming.

2. Best practice when working on Handball: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Handball.
   B. Practise Handball with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Handball.
   D. Damage equipment used for Handball.

3. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Guarantee a trophy
   B. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk
   C. Remove the need for rules
   D. Replace drinking water

4. Best practice when working on Kenyan Indigenous Games: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Kenyan Indigenous Games.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Kenyan Indigenous Games.
   C. Damage equipment used for Kenyan Indigenous Games.
   D. Practise Kenyan Indigenous Games with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

5. Best practice when working on Indigenous Kenyan Craft - Beadwork: (1 mark)

   D. Refuse all feedback on Javelin and Sculpture.

7. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. Only the volume
   B. The ticket price
   C. Only the costume
   D. The speed of the music

8. Best practice when working on Storytelling and Animation: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Storytelling and Animation.
   B. Practise Storytelling and Animation with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Storytelling and Animation.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Storytelling and Animation.

9. Best practice when working on Drawing and Painting: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Drawing and Painting.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Drawing and Painting.
   C. Practise Drawing and Painting with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Drawing and Painting.

10. Best practice when working on Components of Creative Arts and Sports: (1 mark)

   B. Refuse all feedback on Components of Creative Arts and Sports.
   C. Damage equipment used for Components of Creative Arts and Sports.

11. Best practice when working on Rhythm: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Rhythm.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Rhythm.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Rhythm.
   D. Practise Rhythm with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

12. Best practice when working on Descant Recorder: (1 mark)

   B. Damage equipment used for Descant Recorder.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Descant Recorder.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Descant Recorder.

13. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Green, orange, and purple
   B. Black, white, and grey
   C. Red, blue, and yellow
   D. Brown, pink, and gold

14. Best practice when working on Melody: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Melody with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Melody.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to Creative Arts and Sports and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
